classification.difficultyReason: Part c needs the gap between two lines compared across all weeks, a small multi-step comparison. Parts a and b are direct reads.

content.prompt: The line graph shows the heights of two plants over six weeks.

children.label: a
children.prompt: In which week were the two plants the same height?

answer.worked: The two traces meet at week $3$, where both plants are $14\text{ cm}$ tall.

children.label: b
children.prompt: How much taller was Plant B than Plant A in week $6$?

children.label: c
children.prompt: In which week was the difference between their heights the greatest?

answer.short: Week $5$, when the difference is $6\text{ cm}$.
answer.worked:
Before week $3$ the difference is only $2\text{ cm}$. After week $3$:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Week 4}&:20-16=4\text{ cm}\\\text{Week 5}&:24-18=6\text{ cm}\\\text{Week 6}&:24-20=4\text{ cm}\end{align*}$$
The greatest difference is $6\text{ cm}$ in week $5$.
